construction: Append the exact archive DP identity without .fits. This is a file endpoint, not the ObsCore access_url DataLink document. No credentials, redirects or DataLink followups are used by the downloader.

primary_sources.evidence: Official notebook Example1 In[3] shows archive_id ADP.2024-03-19T05:58:04.407 mapped to https://dataportal.eso.org/dataPortal/file/ADP.2024-03-19T05:58:04.407 and analogous science/ancillary examples. The individual archive_id identifies the file; estimated sizes can change if FITS headers are patched.
ObsCore access_url identifies a DataLink metadata resource that lists related files; it is not itself the primary spectrum payload.

url_only_lookup_note: Separate saved official-demo download/debug lookup returned a DataLink URL with eso_download=file. That lookup did not retrieve a spectrum or resolve a target download. Direct-file contract above is supported by the official notebook and prior acquisition receipts.
